recap.text: Donut finds one item in her boss box: an Enchanted Fur Brush of the Ecclesiastic, which adds two points of Constitution for thirty hours if someone brushes her ten minutes every night. Carl reckons it beats nothing, though her Constitution is only four. At the table, the safe room's Bopca Protector brushes her while crawlers die on the screen and Carl barely tastes his fried chicken. The buff began many minutes ago, but Donut demands more.

Mordecai lays out a daily schedule and has found what looks like a dry erase board to write it on. The day runs: wake, eat, apply buffs, which means a shower and a brushing for Donut while Carl works on his feet, then an hour in the training room on one skill. Today Mordecai picks Smush, since only one skill can be trained a day, even where skills overlap.

In the Scab box, Donut's Enchanted Fur Brush of the Ecclesiastic is upgraded to add ten percent to her constitution, on top of the measly two points a morning brushing gives. The haul brings a coupon for a Town Upgrade and a potion for her Love Vampire skill. Donut, with a program to go on, tells Bomo, busy at the Gamecube, to be a darling and brush her out; he does, happily, if less eagerly than the Sledge.

beats.headline: Ten minutes every night
beats.text: Donut combs through her achievements and boxes and finds nothing noteworthy except one item. Her boss box holds an Enchanted Fur Brush of the Ecclesiastic, which works much like Carl's pedicure kit: as long as someone brushes her for ten minutes every night, she gets an extra two points of Constitution for thirty hours. It is better than nothing, Carl reckons, but even with the buff her Constitution is only four.
beats.gist: Donut's Fur Brush of the Ecclesiastic adds two Constitution for thirty hours after ten minutes' nightly brushing.

beats.headline: She demands more brushing
beats.text: On the screen the shots keep coming, crawlers being slaughtered, and Carl can barely taste his fried chicken. At the table, Donut sits being lovingly groomed with her new brush by the safe room's Bopca Protector. The constitution buff activated many minutes ago. She demands he keep brushing. People are asleep in all twenty of the safe room's rooms for rent.
beats.gist: Donut sits being groomed with her new brush by the Bopca Protector while Carl barely tastes his chicken.

beats.headline: Part of the schedule
beats.text: Mordecai rambles about maintaining a schedule, and has somehow found what appears to be a dry erase board to mark it on. Wake, eat, apply buffs, which means showering and brushing Donut while Carl works on his feet, then an hour in the training room on one skill. Today Mordecai wants Smush. Apparently only one skill can be trained a day, even where skills overlap.
beats.gist: Mordecai plans the day on a dry erase board: today's hour of training goes to Smush.

beats.headline: Ten percent more
beats.text: In the Scab box, Donut receives an upgrade to her brush: the Enchanted Fur Brush of the Ecclesiastic now adds a further ten percent to her constitution, on top of the measly two points it normally gives for getting brushed each morning. The same haul brings a coupon for a free Town Upgrade and a skill potion for her Love Vampire skill.
beats.gist: In the Scab box, Donut's Fur Brush of the Ecclesiastic upgrades to add ten percent more constitution.

beats.headline: Bomo, be a darling
beats.text: Donut has a program to go on, so she turns to Bomo, who is busy playing on the Gamecube: be a darling and brush me out. They say their goodbyes while Bomo brushes her. The cretin does it happily, though he is not nearly as enthusiastic about it as the Sledge had been.
beats.gist: Donut has Bomo brush her out while he plays the Gamecube; he does, less eagerly than the Sledge.
